Alien Clinical Rescue

Awesome-O has been abducted! The aliens will release our robot buddy only after a human proves Earth nursing is ready for the galaxy. Restore five ship systems by making safe clinical decisions.

Funny and PG-13: no gore, no exposed anatomy, and the suspicious “probe” is only a glowing scanner prop kept at a respectful distance.
